name: Back Office Reviews
description: Reviews from Google, Tripadvisor and the website in one list, unanswered first, with a reply box that suggests the right tone for low and high ratings.
usage: Give it the /admin/reviews route. Load reviews from the platforms' APIs (Google Business Profile, Tripadvisor) or your own review form, and post replies in onReply. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
